title: These Limited-Edition KATSEYE Press-Ons Nail the 3D Artwork Trend
summary: The collection features reusable press-on nails and 3D charms.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

KATSEYE are putting their pinkies (and the rest of their digits) up as part of a new press-on nails collaboration.

The new KATSEYE x Never Have I Ever press-on nails collection brings the global girl group’s Wild era straight to your fingertips, with five statement-making designs named after — and inspired by — songs from the band’s latest EP: “Pinky Up,” “Animal,” “Hootie Frutti,” “Bel Air” and “That Way.”

The sets run the style gamut, making it easy to find a look to match your mood, from gothic-inspired artwork and quirky three-dimensional charms to bold animal prints and beachy designs. Each reusable set includes 24 handmade nails in different sizes, glue, adhesive tabs, a cuticle stick, a nail file and an alcohol pad for effortless application.

CROCKERY CHARMS

KATSEYE 'Pinky Up' Press-On Nails

24 Nails

$24.00

Buy Now at Urban Outfitters

Quirky 3D charms.

The most playful set in the collection, “Pinky Up” is a cheeky nod to the song about staying unbothered and brushing off the drama. Quirky charms like a teapot, fork and spoon play up the set’s signature baby-pinky-up attitude, while hot pink, blue and green give off a neon look.

Each set includes 24 handmade nails, a nail file, glue, two sheets of 15 adhesive tabs, a cuticle stick and an alcohol pad. Arrange the bonus charms to create an even bolder, more playful finish, then save the reusable set for your next KATSEYE moment.

TIGER STRIPES

KATSEYE Animal Press-On Nails

Sultry and seductive claws.

For a look with a little more bite, “Animal” pairs vivid red with tiger-stripe patterns for a statement-making finish. Pearl accents soften the fierce print, while gold floral charms add an unexpected touch of polish. Every reusable set comes with 24 handmade nails, plus glue, a nail file, 30 adhesive tabs (kind of like nail stickers), a cuticle stick and an alcohol pad, and the bonus charms can be added wherever you like to give this wild look an elevated edge.

BEACH VIBES

KATSEYE Hootie Frutti Press-On Nails

Cute and colorful tips.

Inspired by the song’s colorful music video, “Hootie Frutti” is the set to reach for when you’re spending the day at the beach. Coral-inspired details, ocean blues and sandy white tones create a bright, tropical palette, while pearl and diamond-inspired charms add just the right amount of shimmer without competing with the colorful artwork.

With 24 handmade nails, glue, a nail file, two sheets of 15 adhesive tabs, a cuticle stick and an alcohol pad included, you’ll have everything you need to wear the set wherever the day takes you. Keep the reusable nails on hand for your next sunny escape, and stick on the bonus charms when you’re ready for a fresh look.

GRUNGE STYLE

KATSEYE Bel Air Press-On Nails

Dark and moody vibes.

“Bel Air” takes the collection into darker territory with a grungy, alien-core aesthetic. Cool blue and gray shades give the set an otherworldly feel, while gothic-inspired details add a slightly spooky edge. The result is a moody design — similar to the song it’s named for — that stands apart from the collection’s brighter options.

Inside, you’ll find 24 handmade nails along with glue, a nail file, 30 adhesive tabs, a cuticle stick and an alcohol pad. Play with the bonus charms to create a custom look that leans even further into the eerie, extraterrestrial vibe.

FLORAL DESIGNS

KATSEYE That Way Press-On Nails

Rocker florals.

“That Way” mixes soft florals with moody black tips for a contrast that feels equal parts romantic and creepy. Pearl accents add dimension, while gold star charms bring a subtle celestial finish. The combination is perfect for anyone who likes feminine nail art with a darker twist. To make application easy, each reusable set includes 24 handmade nails, glue, a nail file, two sheets of 15 adhesive tabs, a cuticle stick and an alcohol pad. Mix up the charm placement for a personalized look, or recreate the arrangement pictured for the full effect.

The timing of the new Never Have I Ever press-on nails is especially fitting for fans, as KATSEYE will hit the road for their Wildworld tour this fall. With the North American leg kicking off in October, the press-on collection offers fans a fun way to coordinate their nails with their concert looks.

FIND KATSEYE TICKETS ONLINE

The five Wild -inspired press-on nails also complement the five band members who performed the EP after Manon Bannerman announced her temporary hiatus in February. Since the EP’s release, though, Sophia Laforteza has also stepped back from performing, leaving fans to wonder if the girl group will remain a quartet .
